deposit_title: The gut microbiome and metabolites are altered and interrelated in patients with rheumatoid arthritis
Q3_evidence_quote: metabolomic profiling on feces of 26 untreated RA patients and 26 healthy controls.
Q4_evidence_quote: Each sample was split into two tubes and stored at -80°C until subsequent processing.
notes: Deposit describes 26 RA plus 26 controls (52); publication also describes a separate 11+11 validation cohort. Splitting one fecal specimen into tubes is not proof of one biological collection per participant. The selected assay membership of additional validation samples is not established.

deposit_title: Association between altered tryptophan metabolism, plasma aryl hydrocarbon receptor agonists, and inflammatory Chagas disease
notes: Methods identify Chagas patients and healthy donors but provide no integer human-participant count scoped to LC-MS plasma. Plasma collection described; number of collections per participant unstated. Mouse/cell studies must not be combined with human plasma.

deposit_title: Contributions of the Microbiome-Derived Metabolome for Risk Assessment and Prognostication of Pancreatic Cancer
Q3_evidence_quote: The study included 173 pancreatic cancer cases that were diagnosed within 5 years of blood draw and 863 matched non-cases
notes: The named S2M source is a review, not an assay-scoped subject count. S3 describes a PLCO serum set (173+863) and another plasma test set (99+50+100), but the sealed views do not establish which count corresponds to the selected MetaboLights serum assay.

deposit_title: Identification of a discriminative metabolomic fingerprint of potential clinical relevance in saliva of patients with periodontitis using 1H nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy
Q3_evidence_quote: stimulated saliva of 26 patients with generalized periodontitis (18 chronic and 8 aggressive) was compared to that of 25 healthy controls.
notes: Deposit description and paper Table 1 indicate 26 cases +25 controls analysed; publication recruitment section instead says 26 healthy controls recruited. No explicit one-saliva-sample-per-person statement.

deposit_title: Antiviral metabolite 3'-Deoxy-3',4'-didehydro-cytidine is detectable in serum and identifies acute viral infections including COVID-19
Q3_evidence_quote: When comparing 60 viral with 101 non-viral cases in the discovery cohort
notes: Deposit describes discovery comparison (60+101) and independent validation comparison (40+40), but does not tie a distinct-participant total to selected serum assay. S2M front matter is not a methods account of sampling frequency.

deposit_title: Plasma Lipid Profile Reveals Plasmalogens as Potential Biomarkers for Colon Cancer Screening
Q3_evidence_quote: This cross-sectional study included fifty healthy volunteers from the CTR group and fifty CC patients
notes: Total of 100 patients/volunteers described for plasma lipidomics; cross-sectional design and aliquoting do not explicitly establish one biological collection per participant.

deposit_title: Fecal Metabolomics and Potential Biomarkers for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
Q3_evidence_quote: The cohort consisted of 32 SLE patients, 26 healthy controls (HC) with matched age and gender.
notes: Publication states 32 cases plus 26 controls and table reports corresponding fecal sample counts. Collection within one week of enrollment does not explicitly exclude more than one specimen per person.

deposit_title: Multi-omic Molecular Characterization and Diagnostic Biomarkers for Occult Hepatitis B Infection and HBsAg-Positive Hepatitis B Infection
Q3_evidence_quote: In the discovery cohorts, a total of 50 samples were collected
notes: S3 paper reports 50 discovery and 289 validation samples, but these are sample counts, not a verified number of distinct participants within the selected deposit assay. S3 second paper concerns a different CHB/PD clinical project; not used to infer assay count or sampling.

deposit_title: Altered metabolome and microbiome features provide clues in understanding irritable bowel syndrome and depression comorbidity
Q3_evidence_quote: In total, we recruited 330 and 101 individuals for discovery and validation cohorts, respectively.
notes: Paper reports 330 discovery and 101 validation people, and corresponding 330 and 101 fecal samples; it does not explicitly map the entire 431-person pool to the single chosen deposited assay or establish one biological collection per person. Q3 count is the published fecal-study population; assay attribution should be treated as uncertain.

deposit_title: Microbiome and metabolome patterns centered on cancer cachexia link skeletal muscle and adipose tissue depletion to clinical outcomes in locally advanced rectal cancer
Q3_evidence_quote: By analyzing LC-MS raw data from 133 patients (64 discovery, 69 validation)
Q4_evidence_quote: fecal and blood samples were strictly collected on the second day after initial hospital admission.
notes: Deposit describes 133 LC-MS patients; S3 paper says blood from 154, 134 retained after exclusions, while overall clinical cohort is 198. Published sources conflict by one on assay count; no unambiguous reconciled Q3 count. Baseline second-day timing is not an explicit one-sample-per-person claim.
